shared_security_preset.description: Settings row label that opens the security presets subpage; also the aria-label of the preset radio group

shared_preset_none_selected.description: Settings preset row, small subtitle when the user never picked a preset

shared_translation.description: Settings row label opening the translation subpage

shared_keyboard_shortcuts.description: Settings row label opening the keyboard shortcuts subpage

shared_auto_lock_desc.message: Lock unlocked keys after a period of no activity in the panel. The OS lockscreen always locks immediately regardless of this setting.
shared_auto_lock_desc.description: Settings toggle description under 'Auto-lock after inactivity'

shared_lock_after.description: Label above the auto-lock timeout dropdown

shared_auto_download_files_desc.message: Automatically download after encrypting or decrypting files.

shared_auto_download_text_desc.message: Automatically download after encrypting or decrypting text.

shared_lookup_online_desc.message: Adds a lookup box to the import screen for GitHub SSH keys and keys.openpgp.org certificates. Off means nothing leaves this device to find a key. Turning it on means a lookup tells that host your IP address and who you searched for - it does not tell them anything about your keys or messages.
shared_lookup_online_desc.description: Settings toggle description under 'Look up keys online'. Keep 'GitHub' and 'keys.openpgp.org' as-is; this is a privacy disclosure, translate precisely

shared_crx_signing.description: Settings section heading. CRX is the Chrome extension package format

shared_crx_how.description: Button opening the CRX signing explainer subpage

shared_backup_desc.message: Export your keys and contacts as a single armored file, or restore from one. Exported private keys are encrypted with a passphrase of your choice.

shared_import_keys.description: Backup button opening the import-all subpage
